purpose: Teach: 催眠/列挙/傾斜/海賊/聴覚/電磁波/服用/墜落

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、催眠療法の有効性を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You were writing about the effectiveness of hypnotherapy in your paper, weren't you, Ren?
lines.style: Warm, steady inquiry. Slight upward lift at the end—genuinely curious, checking in. Speaks with the ease of someone who has read his work and remembers it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、優れた俳優を列挙する評論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about critical reviews of accomplished actors.
lines.style: Quiet correction, almost embarrassed. Speaks quickly, not defensive but faintly flustered at the misremembering. The slight stammer of someone catching a gap between what he said and what was heard.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、急傾斜地の防災を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you covered slope stabilization and disaster prevention in yours, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle rephrasing—checking again with the softness of someone who knows they got it wrong before. Curious but careful. Allows space for him to correct her again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海賊船の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the history of pirate ships.
lines.style: Small, patient exhale. No frustration—just quietly persistent in his correction. Speaks evenly, accepting that misunderstandings happen. A touch of resignation that nobody quite has it right.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 動物の聴覚能力を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper was on animal hearing and acoustic perception, correct?
lines.style: Brighter attempt this time—she's trying again. Speaks with slightly more confidence but still holding it lightly. The attentiveness of someone who wants to get it right for him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、電磁波の人体への影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I actually wrote about electromagnetic radiation and its effects on human health.
lines.style: Polite but steady. No sharpness, no edge. The practiced patience of explaining something multiple times without complaint. Almost as if he's helping her learn his work rather than correcting her.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬の長期服用について論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: The long-term effects of medication—that was your focus, wasn't it?
lines.style: One more try, spoken with genuine warmth and hope. Softer, more conversational. She's not reading notes now—she's guessing, and asking forgiveness for it gently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、航空機の墜落事故の原因解析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I wrote about the causes and analysis of aircraft accidents, actually.
lines.style: Soft close. The final correction spoken with kindness—almost protectively toward her. The tone of someone who has accepted that these mismatches will keep happening, and he's made peace with it. Almost fond.
